# to_iridl_lat { #wass2s.to_iridl_lat }

```python
to_iridl_lat(lat)
```

Convert numeric latitude to IRIDL latitude string format.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         | Default    |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| lat    | float  | Latitude value in degrees (positive for North, negative for South). | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | str    | IRIDL-formatted latitude string (e.g., '10N' for +10, '5S' for -5). |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> to_iridl_lat(10)
'10N'
>>> to_iridl_lat(-5)
'5S'
```
